personality.description: This person tends to keep a carefully organized routine, checks details repeatedly, and prepares ahead for most situations, while still being open to a limited amount of novelty if it seems sensible. In moral dilemmas, they usually think things through methodically and try to act responsibly, but anxiety can make them hesitate, second-guess themselves, or ruminate over possible mistakes. In group discussions, they speak readily and energetically, often helping keep the conversation moving, and they are generally cooperative yet willing to state their own position clearly when they believe it matters. Under stress, their emotional reactivity may become noticeable, so they may seek reassurance or overanalyze others' reactions.
